# stb-vorbis

Vendored copy of [`stb-vorbis`](https://github.com/spessasus/stb-vorbis) v0.0.7.

- File: `stb-vorbis.js` (from `dist/index.js`)
- License: Apache-2.0, see `stb-vorbis.LICENSE`
- Purpose: decode Ogg Vorbis audio on browsers without native Ogg support (iOS/WebKit)
- Source integrity: SHA-256 `c25c72096cf2c3d26d078ae0ce3efbd2dd3b177b4a36d3c639c6f4a12a0220b0`

The bundled WebAssembly was compiled from `stb_vorbis.c`, which retains its
original public-domain/MIT dedication.
